product_overview: Magicpie Web Honor Splitter is a web app for managing gig income, calculating production deductions, and splitting net fees across the Magicpie band team. It also supports member and crew management, invitations, itineraries, and exportable gig settlement reports.
core_goals: Sign in or set up the first admin account to access the app
Create, update, and review gig fee settlements
Manage members, crew, production roles, and invite-based access
View personal payout summaries and app settings

features.name: User Login
features.description: Users sign in with email and password to access the app.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit the sign-in form -> See the dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Enter incorrect credentials -> Submit the sign-in form -> See an authentication error message

features.name: First Admin Setup
features.description: The first user can create the initial admin account when no users exist yet.
user_flows: Navigate to /signup -> Fill in name, email, and password -> Submit the admin setup form -> See the dashboard

features.name: Invite Flow
features.description: Admins can invite new users by email, and invited users can accept access through a token link.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings -> Enter an email address and role -> Send the invite -> See the pending invites list
Navigate to /settings -> Review the pending invites list -> Revoke a pending invite -> See the invite removed from the list
Open the invite link with a valid token -> Accept the invitation -> Complete account access setup

features.name: Dashboard
features.description: Users can review overall gig performance and recent gig activity from the dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View gig stats and recent gigs -> Open a gig detail
Navigate to / -> Review the dashboard summary -> Select a gig from recent activity -> See gig details

features.name: Gig Management
features.description: Users can create, edit, organize, and review gigs with fee settlement details and exports.
user_flows: Navigate to /gigs -> Create a new gig -> Fill in event details, client, venue, city, date, gig type, and total fee -> Add members, crew, and expenses -> Save the gig -> See the gig appear in the list with its status badge
Navigate to /gigs -> Open a gig detail -> Review the settlement breakdown -> Change the gig status
Navigate to /gigs -> Open a gig detail -> Export the gig as PDF or Excel -> Save the exported report
Navigate to /gigs -> Open a gig detail -> Delete the gig after confirming the action -> See the gig removed from the list
Navigate to /gigs -> Open a gig detail -> Edit gig information -> Save the changes -> See the updated gig details

features.name: Itinerary Templates
features.description: Users can save reusable itinerary templates and manage template records.
user_flows: Navigate to /itinerary -> View the itinerary template list
Navigate to /itinerary -> Create a new template -> Save the template -> See it appear in the list
Navigate to /itinerary -> Delete a template -> See it removed from the list

features.name: Masters Management
features.description: Users can manage members, crew, and production role presets used across gigs.
user_flows: Navigate to /masters -> View the members and crew lists
Navigate to /masters -> Add a new member or crew entry -> Save the entry -> See it appear in the list
Navigate to /masters -> Edit an existing member or crew entry -> Save the changes -> See the updated entry
Navigate to /masters -> Delete a member or crew entry -> Confirm the deletion -> See the entry removed
Navigate to /masters -> Manage production roles -> Save a production role preset -> See it available for use

features.name: Member Dashboard
features.description: Each user can view their own payout summary and per-gig earnings.
user_flows: Navigate to /me -> View own payout summary and per-gig earnings
Navigate to /me -> Review the payout breakdown -> Compare earnings across gigs

features.name: Settings
features.description: Users can update app settings, manage invites, and review audit logs.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings -> Edit settings fields -> Save the settings -> See the updated values persist
Navigate to /settings -> View audit log entries -> Review recent activity
Navigate to /settings -> Enter an email and role for a new invite -> Send the invite -> See the pending invites list

known_limitations.issue: Public signup is disabled once any user exists; new users must be invited
known_limitations.impact: Test flows must log in with an existing account or use the invite flow

known_limitations.issue: Database is a local SQLite file (magicpie.db), not a remote production DB
known_limitations.impact: Data persists only on the local machine

known_limitations.issue: Google social login requires OAuth env configuration
known_limitations.impact: Social login may fail if GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID/SECRET are not configured
